exclusion_detail: Lead GQ127 is made from commercial N-Cbz amino acids by phenacyl ester formation/imidazole ring closure (7), N-alkylation with ethyl bromoacetate (8), hydrogenolysis/lactamization (9), BH3 reduction (10), HATU coupling with a protected amino acid and TFA deprotection: at least 6 reactions even counting the ester + NH4OAc cyclisation as one pot.

lead.label: GQ127
lead.why: Abstract: 'The most promising compound GQ127 showed good efficacy and safety in inositol monophosphate (IP1) assay ...'

notes: All GQ111-GQ166 share the same imidazopiperazine core sequence (Scheme 1: i-ix), so no compound in the series has a route of 4 reactions or fewer. No SI file in the bundle.
